findings.title: Commit points are checkbox task items instead of plain-line `**Commit**:` markers
findings.description: The commit points are written as checklist tasks — `- [ ] **Task 2C: Commit** — ...` (lines 71, 94, 117, 126, 134). The marker convention requires commit markers to be plain lines, never checkboxes, so they are not consumed as completable work items. Placement is correct — 2C/3C/4C sit at working, tested points after each implementation+test pair, and 5C/6C are correctly conditional — and the semantic commit messages follow the git rules, so this is a form fix only: render the five entries as plain `**Commit**: \`feat(...)\`` lines rather than checkbox "Task XC" items.

findings.title: All slice-design success criteria trace to tasks
findings.description: Cross-reference confirmed with no gaps and no scope creep: FR "PASS/exit 0 for designs the script passes" → Task 4T + Task 5 parity sweep; "FAIL + one `missing:` line per section, exit 1" → Task 4T; doctype message → Tasks 3/3T/4T; multi-file order and continue-on-fail → Tasks 3T/4T; the full exit-2 matrix (empty stdout in both modes, valid-file-before-missing test, `cf guides update` message, template with no required headings) → Tasks 3/3T/4T; `--json` contract → Task 4/4T; worktree-local template → Task 4/4T. Technical requirements map to Task 2T (all normalization cases incl. CRLF and fence handling), Task 3T (real-template assertion — the template does mark `## Overview` and `### Verification Walkthrough` required at template lines 33–34 and 140–141, so the assertion is viable), Task 4T (real designs from `project-documents/user/slices/`, which exist), and Task 6 (build/lint/suite, ~300-line limits). The Integration Requirement and Verification Walkthrough steps 1–6 are covered by Task 5. No NFR is restated, so no load-test or CI-wiring task is required. Referenced symbols and patterns were verified to exist as described: `GUIDE_RELATIVE_PATH` (packages/core/src/guides/types.ts:313), the explicit `guides/index.ts` barrel (line 24, so Task 1's conditional step is grounded), `frontmatterSchema`/`frontmatterFileValidator` export locations (packages/core/src/index.ts:39, packages/core/src/node.ts:29), `parseFrontmatter` (node.ts:34), and the `frontmatter` subcommand's `resolveProjectWorktree`/`resolveOperationPath`/`handleError(err, 2)` pattern (packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts:11-14,154,165,255). Test tasks immediately follow their implementation tasks, dependencies flow one way (2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6), and the bash parity script exists at the path Task 5 names.
